items.title:
app.doqa:doqa-client 0.1.4 发布, Reusable JVM client core for the DoQA Autotest API: configuration resolution
        (system properties over environment over properties file), model builders serializing
        to the API contract, an HTTP client with token auth, retries and timeouts,
        run-selection modes, and an Allure-compatible file sink. No runtime dependencies:
        HTTP via java.net.http (JDK 11+), JSON via a small built-in codec, so any
        test-framework adapter can build on top of it.

se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom 1.1.1 发布, Bill of Materials for the VibeTags annotation processor. Import this BOM to get
        a coherent vibetags-annotations + vibetags-processor pair without specifying
        each version individually.

        Recommended setup — annotations on the compile classpath, processor on the
        annotation-processor path only (the processor jar pulls in slf4j/logback,
        which has no business on consumer code's compileClasspath):

        Maven:
            <dependencyManagement>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>
                        <artifactId>vibetags-bom</artifactId>
                        <version>1.1.1</version>
                        <type>pom</type>
                        <scope>import</scope>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
            </dependencyManagement>

        Gradle:
            implementation platform('se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom:1.1.1')
            annotationProcessor platform('se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom:1.1.1')
            compileOnly 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations'
            annotationProcessor 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-processor'

se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-cli 1.1.1 发布, Companion command-line tool for VibeTags: `init` bootstraps a project's opt-in
        files (file presence is the opt-in signal the processor honours), `doctor`
        reports the project's VibeTags health — build-tool wiring, active platforms,
        marker integrity. Run it without installing anything:

            jbang se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-cli:1.1.1 init --list

        The platform list and marker rules are read from vibetags-processor, so this
        tool cannot drift from what the processor actually does.
